title: Institutional Securities Group Central Risk Team, Full Stack Developer, Manager, Mumbai
description:
Institutional Securities Group Central Risk Team, Full Stack Developer , Manager, Mumbai
  
  
This role sits within the ISGM Strategist team supporting the ISGM Central Risk organization. The team designs and develops technology solutions that enhance risk management, regulatory oversight, workflow automation, and management reporting across Institutional Securities businesses.
  
  
The Central Risk team within Institutional Securities Group (ISG) provides oversight of regulatory and firm requirements for supervision, Surveillance, entitlements, Model Risk, Third party Risk, Operational risk and information security by performing in-depth assessments and aimplementing consistent programmatic coverage globally for Institutional Equities, Fixed Income, Global Capital Markets, Investment Banking and Research. The team seeks to ensure front-office compliance with all applicable rules and regulations governing the firm, as well as adherence to internal standards, controls, and policies.
  
  
The ISG Central Risk team fulfils a front office advisory role as the first line of defence. The scope includes escalation, oversight, project execution, control ownership and is the default owner for many division-wide audit and regulatory issues.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Design, develop, and maintain web-based applications supporting regulatory, supervisory, surveillance, and operational risk processes.
* Build scalable front-end and back-end solutions using modern software development frameworks and engineering best practices.
* Enhance existing risk management platforms, workflows, reporting tools, and management information systems.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Business Control, and Technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective technology solutions.
* Develop automated workflows, dashboards, reporting solutions, and system integrations that improve operational efficiency and control effectiveness.
* Design and optimize data models, APIs, and database structures to support business and analytical requirements.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Ensure applications meet firm standards for security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Contribute to technical architecture decisions, coding standards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support strategic automation and digitization initiatives that reduce manual effort and enhance risk management outcomes.
* Collaborate with global teams and stakeholders to deliver high-quality technology solutions.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, preferably from a top-tier university, with strong programming skills.
* 2–5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including hands-on experience with data analysis and numerical computing libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, along with experience in JavaScript frameworks such as React.
* Experience with Git and GitHub for source code management (SCM), version control, collaborative development, and code review workflows.
* Strong experience with financial modelling and analytical tools, particularly Microsoft Excel.
* Hands-on experience working with MongoDB and SQL databases.
* Experience with data visualization platforms and tools, with the ability to translate complex datasets into clear and actionable insights.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to work thoughtfully, independently, and with minimal supervision.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. title: Senior Consultant - Middleware/OCP
description:
**About The Job**
The Red Hat India Services team is looking for a Consultant to join us in Mumbai, India. In this role, you will help us ensure that our engagements are not just a technology implementation, but an organizational transformation. As a consultant, you will work with our lead architect in our engagements, cocreating innovative software solutions using emerging open source technology and modern software design methods in an agile environment. You’ll be coached by the team to facilitate the design and technical delivery of our solutions. As you do so, you’ll create enthusiasm for building great software using principles of open source and agile culture. You'll support everything from the scoping to delivering the engagements. Successful applicants must reside in a city where Red Hat has mentioned the location.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Applies software engineering principles to the operations domain.
* Ensures service reliability meets users’ needs, including internally critical and externally visible services
* Uses software & systems engineering to design, build, and run large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems
* Develop API’s using Red Hat technology products and service
* Design, develop, and manage Kafka-based data pipelines
* Provide issue analysis on Kafka applications
* Monitor Kafka performance and troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and ensure uninterrupted data flow, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiency.
* Participates in an on-call rotation within a geographically distributed team to provide 24x7x365 production support, with responsibility to respond to urgent customer issues
* Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems
* Help us cover domains including microservices, API management, and web-scale architectures, DevOps engineering and application delivery, container-based continuous delivery (CD), i.e., using Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform,
* Team up with Red Hat and the open source community to engineer innovation-based software solutions, designed to further accelerate our customers’ success at their transformation journey
* Work as a trusted adviser to our customers and use your critical thinking skills to tackle tough problems in an innovative way
* Train and coach team members both on technical and non-technical skills
* Remain an active coder as this is required during our engagements and maintain deep direct technical knowledge of container management systems (CMSs), application infrastructure, architectures, and development solutions
* Support presales and post-sales field teams during workshops, proofs of concepts, pilots, and production deployments

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience and advanced knowledge of middleware technologies, including enterprise web or middleware development project experience with application integration
* Knowledge and some experience in OpenShift by Red Hat;
* Experience with another Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution will also be considered
* Hands on experience using Cloud as a development environment
* JEE and Middleware technology
* Good technical skills and experience designing and implementing JEE solutions.
* Thorough experience with at least one of the major middleware solutions, preferably Red Hat JBoss Middleware; experience in Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, WebMethods, Tibco, etc. will also be considered.
* Hands on experience in application development with Agile approach

* Knowledge on Devops and Microservices
* Enterprise Java development skills are an advantage.
* Knowledge of Hibernate and Tomcat is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience on AMQ, API management like 3scale.

* Experience with or knowledge of Red Hat’s technologies like Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, Red Hat Fuse, Red Hat 3Scale, Red Hat AMQ, or Red Hat AMQ Streams (Kafka)
* Working with some community technologies like Argo CD, Tekton Pipelines, Helm, or Jenkins
* Working with application and infrastructure monitoring
* Experience with or knowledge of JavaScript, Golang, Python, or Shell Scripting
* Experience with or knowledge of technologies AngularJS, React.js, and Vue.js

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: IBM BPM Devloper
description:
**Role: IBM BPM Developer/BAW Developer**

**Location: Goregaon East, Mumbai (local candidates only)**

**Job Type: Fulltime**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Budget: Upto 9 LPA**

**Immediate to 30 Days notice only**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled IBM BPM / BAW Developer with a strong background in Java/JEE enterprise application development and relational databases. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing end-to-end process automation workflows.

A critical component of this role involves utilizing IBM Integration Designer (IID) to build Advanced Integration Services (AIS), BPEL processes, and mediation flows that bridge our workflow engine with complex enterprise backend systems. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between process modelling (Process Designer) and complex backend enterprise integration (IID/Java/SQL).

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Process Automation & Workflow Development**

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end process models using IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / IBM BPM (Process Designer).
* Create and maintain standard/advanced client-side human services, coach views, and custom UI components using JavaScript/CSS.
* Implement complex process logic, tracking groups, timers, gateways, and UCA (Undercover Agents) event handling.

2.
**Advanced Integration & Middleware (IID)**

* Utilize IBM Integration Designer (IID) to develop robust Advanced Integration Services (AIS), Service Component Architecture (SCA) modules, and BPEL (Business Process Execution Language) processes.
* Design and configure custom Mediation Flows, data transformations (XSLT/BO Maps), and adapters (JDBC, Flat File, Web Services) within IID.
* Build, expose, and consume secure corporate enterprise web services (REST APIs and SOAP/WSDL protocols) using XML and JSON data mapping.

3.
**Java Stack & Core Backend Customization**

* Develop custom server-side plugins, integration components, and utility classes using Core Java / JEE to handle complex business logic outside standard out-of-the-box BPM capabilities.
* Write clean, maintainable enterprise Java code, managing object mappings, dependency injection, and advanced multithreaded processing configurations.

4.
**Database & Performance Optimization**

* Write complex, high-performance SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and functions to interact with enterprise relational databases (e.g., Oracle, IBM DB2, or MS SQL Server).
* Design data schemas and optimize database interactions within BPM integration services to minimize latency and avoid process blocking.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance bottlenecks across the BPM runtime, IID SCA modules, and backend database layers.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* BPM Platform: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience explicitly working with IBM BAW (25.x) ecosystems.
* Integration Tooling: Proven expertise with IBM Integration Designer (IID) building advanced SOA-based integration layers and long-running BPEL flows.
* Java Stack: Strong programming proficiency in Core Java, JEE, Hibernate/JPA, and web services infrastructure.
* Database Stack: Solid working knowledge of relational database management systems (RDBMS) with excellent SQL query optimization and stored procedure debugging skills.
* Web Technologies: Comprehensive understanding of Web Services (RESTful APIs, SOAP, WSDL), data exchange formats (XML, XSD, JSON), and frontend languages (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3).
* Methodology: Strong experience working within an Agile/Scrum development model.

**Soft Skills & Educational Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills to trace data across decoupled components (Process Center \rightarrow Advanced Integration Layer / rightarrow DB Engine).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with business analysts, system architects, and project stakeholders.

**Preferred Certifications (Good to Have)**

* IBM Certified Application Developer - Business Automation Workflow / BPM
* Oracle Certified Associate/Professional Java Programmer (OCAJP / OCPJP)

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Clinevo is building our go-to-market engine and looking for folks excited to get their hands dirty in a 0 to 1 journey. If you are expecting a ready-made GTM stack that you only need to maintain, Clinevo Technologies is probably not the right fit for you at this point. However, if you are excited about building the systems from scratch, we would love to hear from you.

We're seeking a hands-on GTM Engineer (B2B Saas) to build the automated systems that find, reach and convert pharmacovigilance buyers for Clinevo Technologies, from data and signals to AI-led outreach, routing and analytics.

You will partner with our sales, marketing, product and tech teams to design, build and run the workflows behind every stage of our funnel. You'll need to possess a strong drive, take ownership of your work, and have an insatiable desire to ship things and make them work.

This role requires a builder with hands-on experience in GTM automation, data enrichment and AI tools, adept at turning manual sales work into repeatable, measurable systems.

**Your responsibility won't be limited to but will include the following:**

* **Data Foundation:**
  Build and maintain a living database of pharma, biotech, CRO, med-device and veterinary companies, with waterfall enrichment for verified contacts and PV-specific data.
* **ICP and Scoring:**
  Define ICP tiers from won and lost deals, and build account and lead scores that blend fit, intent and engagement.
* **Signal Detection:**
  Track regulatory and business signals (FDA warning letters, EMA inspection findings, approvals, leadership changes, M&A, hiring) and route each one to the right play and owner.
* **Inbound Conversion:**
  Build an AI SDR that enriches, qualifies and replies to every website lead in under a minute, 24/7, with instant routing to the right regional rep.
* **Outbound at Scale:**

title: Founding Engineer – Full Stack (Compliance Automation)
description:
**About the Company**

Seclodian develops secure, reliable, and user-friendly technology products. We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer who can contribute to both frontend and backend development while maintaining high standards for security, performance, scalability, and code quality.

**About the role**

You’ll be one of Seclodian’s first engineers. You’ll work directly with the founders to turn compliance requirements into a product that auditors trust and auditees actually like using. You’ll ship across the whole stack (Go, PostgreSQL, Next.js) and help decide how the platform grows.

This role suits you if you’ve seen compliance from the inside. Maybe you built features for a GRC, audit, privacy or regtech product. Maybe you were the engineer who gathered the evidence and closed the findings during a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit. Either way, you now want to build the tool you wished you’d had.

**What you’ll build**

* Data models for frameworks, controls, tests and evidence, so one control can map across SOC 2, ISO 27001 and DPDP without duplicate work.
* Auditor and auditee workflows: engagements, control assignment, evidence upload and review, remediation, and report approval.
* PostgreSQL schemas, migrations and queries for multi-tenant data, where one customer must never see another customer’s data.
* Secure Go APIs (chi, pgx) with authentication and role-based access for auditors, auditees and admins.
* Fast, accessible Next.js and React screens (Tailwind, shadcn/ui) built from our Figma designs.
* Audit trails that record who did what and when, in a form an auditor will accept.
* One product shipped three ways: an on-prem binary on the client’s own server, Docker, and serverless on AWS.
* Work with our AI document-intelligence service, which reads policies and evidence and suggests answers with citations, while people stay in control of what gets accepted.
* Tests, code reviews, production fixes and better monitoring.
* With the founders and compliance experts, turning framework language into clear product behaviour.

**Must-have**

* 2+ years of professional software engineering, building and shipping full-stack products.
* Hands-on compliance experience, in at least one of these ways:
* You built features for a compliance, GRC, audit, privacy or regtech product,
  **or**
* You worked as an engineer through a SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR or DPDP audit or assessment, producing evidence, fixing findings or putting controls in place.
* Working knowledge of at least one of those frameworks. You know what a control is, what counts as evidence and why auditors ask for it.
* Production backend experience in Go. Strong engineers from Java, C# or TypeScript/Node are welcome if they’re ready to go deep on Go quickly.
* Professional frontend experience with React and Next.js in TypeScript.
* Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, indexes, transactions, constraints and migrations.
* You’ve built authentication, authorization and input validation, and you know the OWASP Top 10.
* You write automated tests and can debug problems you didn’t create.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in other regulated domains: fintech, healthtech, insurance.
* Privacy features you’ve built: consent capture, data retention and deletion, or data subject requests under GDPR or DPDP.
* Multi-tenant SaaS, audit logging, or append-only or tamper-evident records.
* Integrations that pull evidence automatically from tools like AWS, Google Workspace, GitHub or Jira.
* Docker, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD.
* Background jobs and queues (Redis, SQS), structured logging, metrics and tracing.
* LLM or RAG systems in production.
* A certification or coursework in ISO 27001, CISA, CISSP or similar (not required).

**Why join now**

* Shape the core product and architecture as one of the first engineers.
* Work directly with the founders on product and engineering decisions.
* Work on a problem that’s growing fast in India as DPDP Act obligations come into force.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Seclodian is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
description:
**Location:**
100% Remote
  
  
**Employment:**
Full-time, long-term position
  
  
**Start date:**
As soon as possible after selection and agreement
  
  
**Salary:**
Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years
  
  
**About Us**
We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
  
  
Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.
  
  
AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.
  
  
You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.
  
  
Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.
  
  
This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
* Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
* Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
* Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
* Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
* Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
* Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
* Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
* Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
* Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
* Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
* Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
* Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
* Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
* Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
* Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
* Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
* A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
* Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
* Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
* Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
* Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
* Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
* The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
* Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
* Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
* Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
* Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
* Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

**Growth, Responsibility And Compensation**
Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.
  
  
Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.
  
  
For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
* The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
* Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
* Close collaboration with startup leadership.
* The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

**Remote Working Arrangement**
Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.
  
  
Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.
  
  
**How To Apply**
We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.
  
  
Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:
  
  

* A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
* An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
* Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
* A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
* Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

Technology / Digital Solutions

**Experience:**
Approximately 10 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Roofsol Energy**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.
  
  
We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.
  
  
Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.
  
  
As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.

* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel

* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.

**Role Summary**

Verdantis is hiring a hands-on engineering leader to run the MRO360 team. The role combines technical leadership — architecture, delivery, and mentorship — with real coding across backend, frontend, and AI workflows. A core focus is establishing disciplined, agentic development practices: using AI coding agents to accelerate delivery while enforcing rigorous human review, testing, and production accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Own architecture and technical direction across backend, frontend, AI workflows, and integrations
* Translate product requirements into technical designs and shipped software
* Partner with product, AI, QA, DevOps, and customer-facing teams; surface risks early

**Hands-On Coding**

* Write and review production code across the stack; build APIs, services, and UI features
* Debug complex issues and improve performance, reliability, and observability

**Agentic Coding & AI-Native Engineering**

* Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar coding agents in real workflows
* Build internal agents for code review, test generation, documentation, and refactoring
* Set guardrails, prompts, and standards governing what agents may change vs. what requires human review
* Red-team AI-generated code for hallucinated logic, security gaps, and weak tests before merge

**AI Product Development**

* Collaborate with AI engineers on LLM features, RAG pipelines, and data enrichment workflows
* Balance AI capability against accuracy, cost, latency, and customer trust

**Team Leadership**

* Mentor engineers through design and code review; set standards for quality and delivery
* Support hiring and build a culture of ownership and disciplined AI tool use

**Candidate Requirements**

**Must-Have**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years in a technical lead / staff role
* Strong coding ability in at least two of: Node.js, Python, Java, React
* Experience building SaaS, enterprise, or AI-enabled products
* Practical, real-world use of AI coding tools or agents — not just autocomplete
* Ability to design simple agentic systems (LLM APIs, tool calling, structured outputs)
* Solid grasp of backend APIs, databases, auth, CI/CD, and production debugging
* Strong communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Strong Advantage**

* Experience with LLM apps, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
* Experience building developer-productivity agents (file edits, test runs, PR summaries)
* Familiarity with MRO, EAM, ERP, or procurement systems (SAP, Oracle, Maximo, Ariba, Coupa)
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and 0→1 or 1→10 product building

**Success in the First 90 Days**

* Understand the MRO360 product and architecture; take ownership of a module or technical area
* Stand up at least one working coding-agent workflow (e.g., PR review, test generation)
* Establish a review path so AI-written code is challenged by tests and senior judgment before production
* Ship production-quality features and identify weak spots in architecture and workflow

**Ideal Fit**

This role suits a builder-leader who still enjoys writing code, has used AI coding tools seriously in production settings, and can red-team AI-generated output rather than accept it at face value. It is not suited to a pure management profile, someone who treats agent output as a shortcut around review, or someone who cannot operate production systems without AI assistance.

title: Senior Shopify Developer_Mumbai
description:
**Company Description**
DooDigital.co is a North America–focused digital agency with nearly 25 years of experience in E-commerce and nutraceutical marketing. The company specializes in scaling wellness and nutraceutical brands through AI-driven marketing, performance-based growth strategies, and digital transformation. By leveraging advanced AI tools such as Perplexity, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek, DooDigital.co builds marketing ecosystems that predict consumer behavior, optimize engagement, and drive measurable business growth. Areas of expertise include performance marketing, AI-powered lead generation, marketing automation, customer engagement, eCommerce solutions, and AI-driven SEO. DooDigital.co is dedicated to helping wellness brands thrive with intelligent, scalable, and high-impact digital strategies.

Doo Digital is an ecommerce marketing agency working with DTC brands across North America. Most of our clients are on Shopify, and we’re hiring a Senior Shopify developer to handle the build, customisation, and ongoing management of those stores.

What you’ll work on

* Building and customising Shopify stores using paid themes from the Shopify Theme Store.
* Editing Liquid templates and theme settings to match the brand and the design files.
* Setting up and managing Shopify apps — subscriptions, reviews, upsells, email, search, and the rest of the usual stack.
* Site speed and Core Web Vitals work — GTmetrix scores, image optimisation, lazy loading, cleaning up render-blocking scripts.
* Managing builds from kickoff to launch — scope, timelines, milestones, QA.
* Leading a small dev team — assigning work, reviewing code, helping juniors get unstuck.
* Owning the technical conversation with clients on what’s feasible, what it’ll take, what the trade-offs are.
* Working with the design team so what gets built actually matches what was designed.

Who we’re looking for

* 3–5 years of Shopify experience, ideally across multiple live stores.
* Solid Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS — comfortable in the theme codebase.
* Hands-on with the Shopify App Store ecosystem — picking the right app, configuring it, knowing where its limits are.
* Site speed optimisation experience — GTmetrix, PageSpeed Insights, and the usual fixes.
* Has shipped multiple Shopify stores end-to-end — kickoff, build, launch.
* Comfortable splitting time roughly 50/50 between coding and managing the work.
* Clean version control and code review habits.
* Clear written English — you’ll be on briefs and client calls every week.

Nice to have

* Shopify Plus exposure.
* Past agency experience — comfortable juggling multiple brands and shifting priorities.
* Familiarity with common Shopify apps — Klaviyo, Recharge, Judge.me, Yotpo, Loox.
* Basic on-page SEO awareness — meta, schema, structured data, redirects.
* Past work with DTC supplements, beauty, or similar ecommerce categories.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack (Gurugram Based)
description:
**About Agoda**
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
  
  
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
  
  
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
  
  
**Get to Know our Team:**
The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end-to-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go-to people who design and implement new systems and components. We are looking for people who are passionate to take on more responsibility and driving major architectural changes in Agoda. It's expected from you in this role as Staff engineer to push Agoda forward technically by adopting new technologies and setting higher standards.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Make
  
  

* Lead full-stack architecture and system design for features used by millions of customers across web and cross-platform environments.
* Own complex end-to-end systems: Take responsibility for building, integrating, and maintaining both frontend and backend components, including the critical Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer.
* Mentor and guide high-performing teams: Provide technical leadership, drive engineering excellence, and support the growth of your peers.
* Drive technical decisions: Influence architecture and best practices across multiple squads, ensuring scalable, reliable, and high-quality solutions.
* Collaborate with Product and Design: Work closely with cross-functional partners to deliver cohesive, user-centered features and experiments that directly impact business outcomes.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong record of technical leadership and end-to-end ownership.
* Expertise in Java, Kotlin, .NET, and JavaScript/TypeScript, plus hands-on experience with frameworks such as Node.js and React (or similar TypeScript frameworks).
* Proven experience leading end-to-end architecture on high-traffic, high-availability platforms, ideally with exposure to cross-platform or migration projects (e.g., native to WebView).
* BFF (Backend for Frontend) experience is a must: You have designed, built, or maintained BFF layers (language flexible—C#, Kotlin, Java, etc.) that bridge frontend and backend systems.
* Track record of technical mentorship, cross-team collaboration, and solving ambiguous, complex problems in fast-paced environments.
* Strong API and middleware skills: Ability to design and implement APIs and backend services tailored for frontend needs.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Scala or other JVM languages.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, microservices, and modern DevOps practices.
* Prior work on large-scale migration or cross-platform initiatives.
* Android and/or iOS native development experience

**This position is based in Gurgaon, India.**
**#india #newdelhi #Bangalore #Bengaluru #Pune #Hyderabad #Chennai #Kolkata #Lucknow #Mumbai #Delhi #Noida #Gurugram #Gurgaon**

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**
As part of Mondelēz International Digital Services, you have leadership responsibility for a specific discipline that may include partnering with leaders in sales, finance, marketing, customer service and logistics, procurement, HR etc. You are part of a team that delivers best-in-class service and value creation to their clients and that always strives for operational excellence.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will work with others to ensure that processes are understood and that changes are effectively implemented. To excel in this role, you will keep a close track on actions and issues and ensure they are resolved on a timely basis. In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring that services are provided and measured, including vendor management, contract management and service level agreements, offer suggestions to other stakeholders to enhance the experience strategy, ensure value delivery using performance metrics and analysis, and work with others to achieve operational excellence and continuous improvement to ensure customer-focused delivery of services.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
  
  

* Working in a project-driven organization
* Managing multiple and diverse stakeholders
* Your specific discipline (in-depth)
* Change management and governance processes
* Influencing and communicating with others
* Presentation skills
* Compliance and controls (experience in audits or part of programs where compliance is important)
* Working effectively in a constantly changing environment and using initiative and personal resourcefulness

**Job Profile Summary**
As part of Mondelēz Digital Services, you will play a key techno-functional role within the Customer Care product team, shaping customer care capabilities across process, technology, data, and service operations.
  
  
Customer Care is focused on improving how we serve customers, reducing friction, and strengthening execution against customer and business priorities across the OTC chain, including exception management across order management, fulfilment, delivery, invoicing, query management, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
You will translate customer care needs into scalable product capabilities, workflows, functional requirements, data requirements, and integration designs. This role requires strong hands-on SAP design experience to enable the customer care solution, including the underlying OTC processes, data structures, integrations, and system dependencies, even where the end solution is delivered through platforms beyond SAP.
  
  
It requires a combination of technical depth, techno-functional design capability, and strategic thinking to shape scalable product solutions and support large-scale transformation across process and technology in complex global environments.
  
  
This role is the bridge between strategic vision and hands-on delivery for Customer Care and OTC technology. The person in the seat will own the technology strategy and roadmap, lead vendor assessment and selection, drive global solution design, and keep a sharp eye on Total Cost of Ownership — all while being comfortable rolling up their sleeves to design solutions, not just direct them.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* 17+ years of experience across Customer Care / Customer Service / OTC in complex FMCG environments with over 5 years of experience in a role with strategic focus.
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled service capabilities, including intelligent triage, summarisation, recommendations, automation, and agent assist, and the ability to translate these into product and workflow requirements.
* Strong experience across customer-facing and service-related OTC processes, including order management, fulfilment, delivery, invoicing, query management, exception handling, and cross-functional issue resolution.
* 15+ years of hands-on techno-functional solution design experience, translating business needs into product capabilities, workflows, functional specifications, data requirements, integration requirements, and scalable technology-enabled solutions.
* 19+ years of strong hands-on SAP design experience across OTC processes, including process flows, configuration implications, data structures, integration touchpoints, and end-to-end solution design support.
* Proven experience working closely with architecture, integration, product, and delivery teams to shape and implement fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Strong understanding of OTC-relevant master and transactional data, and ability to use this to support product design, visibility needs, workflow requirements, reporting, and process mining opportunities.
* Experience with process mining / operational analytics tools such as Celonis
* Proven experience in large-scale transformation across process and technology.
* Demonstrated ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, shaping scalable solutions aligned with longer-term product and service priorities

**Required Experience**

* Define and own the end-to-end technology strategy for Customer Care / Customer Service / OTC, aligned with the broader enterprise architecture and product roadmap.
* Develop and maintain a clear, compelling technology vision that connects business priorities to platform, product, and capability choices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies — including AI-enabled service capabilities (intelligent triage, summarisation, recommendations, automation, agent assist) — and translate them into actionable product and workflow requirements.
* Shape the evolution of the Customer Care product across OTC to improve service effectiveness, reduce friction, and strengthen execution.
* Define how the product should enable better customer interaction, workflow management, visibility, collaboration, and exception handling across the OTC chain.

**Vendor Assessment & Selection**

* Lead structured vendor assessment and selection processes for Customer Care platforms, tools, and enabling technologies.
* Develop evaluation frameworks (functional fit, scalability, integration, cost, risk) and run competitive benchmarking.
* Negotiate and shape vendor relationships in partnership with Procurement and Legal.
* Manage and challenge external Vendors and SI Partners to ensure fit-for-purpose delivery, strong design quality, and disciplined cost control aligned with Product and Program priorities.

**Global Solution Design**

* Support and drive the global design of new solutions across OTC processes: order management, fulfilment, delivery, invoicing, query management, exception handling, and cross-functional issue resolution.
* Translate business needs and operational pain points into scalable product capabilities, process requirements, data needs, and technology design inputs.
* Provide hands-on SAP design expertise across OTC processes — process flows, configuration implications, data structures, integration touchpoints, and end-to-end solution design.
* Ensure product design is grounded in the realities of OTC processes, related functional systems like SAP, relevant data, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Work closely with architecture, integration, product, and delivery teams to shape and implement fit-for-purpose solutions.

**Product Roadmap & Continuous Improvement**

* Help shape the product roadmap by balancing strategic priorities, operational value, standardisation opportunities, and technical feasibility.
* Drive continuous improvement through stronger use of process insight, data, analytics, and digital capabilities, including AI where relevant.
* Champion the use of process mining / operational analytics tools (e.g. Celonis) to uncover optimisation opportunities.
* Bring an external market and benchmark perspective, leveraging sources such as Hackett, Gartner, and broader industry practices, to keep the product vision current and continuously inject ideas that strengthen service capability and competitive advantage.

**TCO Management & Optimisation**

* Own and monitor Total Cost of Ownership across the Customer Care technology landscape.
* Identify and drive opportunities to reduce TCO through rationalisation, consolidation, automation, and smarter sourcing.
* Build and maintain a transparent cost model that supports informed investment decisions.

**Delivery Support**

* Support successful delivery through clear requirements, strong design traceability, testing support, and resolution of design or process issues.
* Leverage understanding of OTC-relevant master and transactional data to support product design, visibility needs, workflow requirements, reporting, and process mining opportunities.

**Education / Certifications**

* University degree, preferably in Business, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven English language proficiency.

No Relocation support available
  
  
**Business Unit Summary**
At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.
  
  
We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as
*Oreo*
,
*belVita*
and
*LU*
biscuits;
*Cadbury Dairy Milk*
,
*Milka*
and
*Toblerone*
chocolate;
*Sour Patch Kids*
candy and
*Trident*
gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.
  
  
Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.
  
  
Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
**Job Type**
Regular

title: AWS Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with strong AWS expertise and hands-on experience building and deploying Agentic AI use cases. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in frontend and backend development, AWS cloud services, and Generative AI application development using Amazon Bedrock.
  
  
The candidate should be capable of delivering end-to-end AI-powered applications, including AI agents, workflow automation, API integrations, and data visualization solutions. Experience with AWS Kiro, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon QuickSight is highly desirable for developing and deploying intelligent enterprise applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
* Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, including AI agents, tool calling, multi-step reasoning workflows, and enterprise automation.
* Develop Generative AI applications using foundation models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and prompt engineering.
* Use AWS Kiro to accelerate AI-assisted software development, prototyping, coding, and application delivery.
* Integrate Amazon Bedrock with AWS services, databases, APIs, and enterprise systems.
* Develop interactive dashboards and data visualization solutions using Amazon QuickSight.
* Build secure, scalable backend services, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Deploy, monitor, and optimize applications on AWS using appropriate cloud-native services.
* Implement authentication, authorization, logging, error handling, and security best practices.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into production-ready solutions.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and ensure the reliability, scalability, and maintainability of deployed applications.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Full Stack Development: 5+ years of hands-on experience developing frontend and backend applications.
* AWS Cloud: Strong practical experience with AWS services and application deployment.
* AWS Certification: Must hold a valid AWS certification; candidates should specify the certification name.
* Amazon Bedrock: Hands-on experience building Generative AI applications using Amazon Bedrock.
* Agentic AI: Proven experience implementing and delivering Agentic AI use cases, preferably in production environments.
* AWS Kiro: Practical familiarity with Kiro and AI-assisted development workflows.
* Amazon QuickSight: Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualizations.

**Technical Skills**

* Frontend: React.js, Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3.
* Backend: Node.js, Python, Java, or equivalent backend technologies.
* AWS Services: Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and other relevant AWS services.
* Generative AI: LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and foundation models.
* Agentic AI: Agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-step workflows, API integrations, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Data & Visualization: Amazon QuickSight, SQL, data integration, dashboard development, and reporting.
* DevOps & Deployment: Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and cloud application deployment.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter.
  
  
Trusted by
**leading brands**
across three continents, including
**Gymshark**
,
**Huel and Oh Polly,**
Fospha
**manages $4 billion**
in annual ad spend.
  
  
We're scaling fast across
**London, Mumbai, and Austin**
– and we're now looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Team!
  
  
**The Role**
As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll build the products our customers rely on every day to make multi-million dollar media decisions. You'll work across the full stack - from crafting responsive, intuitive frontend experiences through to designing and scaling the backend microservices that power them - and, given the seniority of this role, you'll also help shape system design and infrastructure decisions as we scale.
  
  
You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, where lean, high-autonomy teams ship fast and learn faster. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who's comfortable owning a feature end-to-end - from initial design through to production - and who wants to grow their craft in a fast-moving, ambitious environment.
  
  
Where you'll focus
  
  

* Frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks (React.js or Next.js)
* Backend development using Python-based microservices
* System design and infrastructure, contributing to architectural decisions as we scale
* End-to-end feature ownership across the stack
* (Nice-to-have) Exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering workflows

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain full stack features - from frontend UI/UX through to backend services and APIs in Python.
* Contribute to system design and infrastructure decisions, helping evolve our technical foundations as we scale.
* Get involved across the full Software Development Lifecycle, from initial planning and design through execution, release, and monitoring in production.
* Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, and champion good engineering practices across the team.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into working software.
* Build and consume APIs (REST/GraphQL) that connect frontend experiences to backend services.
* Work with AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, using clear specifications to shape high- quality, AI-assisted engineering work.
* Take ownership of the quality, performance, and reliability of the features you ship.
* Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving candid, constructive feedback.
* Stay curious about new tools and technologies, including opportunities to explore Data Science / Data Engineering problems as they arise.

**What are we looking for?**

* Have around 5+ years of professional experience as a full stack / senior software engineer, with a balanced skill set across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
* Have strong, hands-on experience with front-end technologies such as React.js or Next.js, and solid backend experience building and maintaining Python-based microservices.
* Are comfortable contributing to system design and infrastructure decisions, reflecting the seniority of this role.
* Are comfortable working across the full stack and can move fluidly between frontend, backend, and infrastructure concerns.
* Have solid experience working in an agile environment and know how to embed quality into fast-moving teams.
* Bring exceptional attention to detail and a genuine ownership mindset over what you build.
* Are enthusiastic about new technologies, with the ability to adapt and learn quickly - we're open to candidates with strong experience in other modern languages/frameworks if the core skill set and seniority are a strong match.
* Have an awareness of spec-driven AI development and how clear specifications shape the quality of AI- assisted engineering work.
* Have the confidence and initiative to evolve ideas and pull pieces of work together into meaningful change.
* Have an active interest in self-learning and growing your craft.
* Nice-to-have: exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering (not core to the role, but a strong plus).

You don't have to tick every box. If you're a strong engineer who's hungry to step up, we'd still like to hear
  
  
from you.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot, and learn from the incredible talent in BC.
* Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities
* Flexible Benefits including Private Medical Subsidiaries, Life Assurance, Pension scheme etc
* 25 days of paid holiday + your birthday off!
* Quarterly team socials

**Our Values and Principles -**
You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:
  
  

* Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
* Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
* Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
* Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
* Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!

title: Application Developer-Cloud Fullstack
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Developer: Cloud FullStack, you will develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components. You will utilize expertise in multiple layers of application development to deliver efficient and secure cloud-based solutions.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design and Develop Applications: Develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components, and persisting data in NoSQL or RDBMS databases.
* Apply DevOps Methodologies: Utilize DevOps methodologies and tools to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications.
* Collaborate on Cloud Environments: Work with senior level practitioners to design, build, and maintain cloud environments, focusing on uptime, access, control, and network security using automation and configuration management tools.
* Integrate Multiple Technologies: Integrate multiple technologies, including Angular, React, CSS3, HTML5, Java, JEE, Spring, Hibernate, Groovy, REST/SOA services, APIGEE, API Connect, and NoSQL/RDBMS databases, to deliver comprehensive cloud-based solutions.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Application Development: Exposure to developing and deploying cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components, and persisting data in NoSQL or RDBMS databases.
* Multi-Layered Application Development: Experience working with multiple layers of application development, including front-end technologies such as Angular, React, CSS3, and HTML5, and back-end technologies such as Java, JEE, Spring, Hibernate, and Groovy.
* DevOps Methodologies: Exposure to utilizing DevOps methodologies and tools to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications.
* Cloud Environment Maintenance: Experience working with cloud environments, focusing on uptime, access, control, and network security using automation and configuration management tools.
* Technology Integration: Exposure to integrating multiple technologies, including REST/SOA services, APIGEE, API Connect, and NoSQL/RDBMS databases, to deliver comprehensive cloud-based solutions.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Cloud Security Knowledge: Exposure to implementing cloud security measures, including network security and access control, to ensure the integrity of cloud-based applications.
* Advanced DevOps Tools: Experience working with advanced DevOps tools and methodologies to optimize the development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications.
* Multi-Cloud Environments: Exposure to designing, building, and maintaining multi-cloud environments, focusing on uptime, scalability, and automation.
