title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product Manager

Tuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)

About Tuning Research

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

About the role

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.

**Description**
**About the Role**
The oil, gas and chemical sector is undergoing a profound and accelerating transformation. To maintain a competitive edge in an increasingly dynamic market, our organization is embracing digitalization and automation to enhance operational efficiency, improve safety standards, and drive long-term sustainability goals. This role is not merely about writing code or managing systems — it is about fundamentally reshaping how we operate. You will stand at the forefront of this transformation, harnessing cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges: from optimizing production workflows and predicting maintenance needs, to ensuring the security and resilience of our critical infrastructure.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and results-driven Senior Technology Solution Specialist to join our technology team. In this pivotal role, you will design, develop, and deploy software solutions that power our digital initiatives — playing a crucial part in building, implementing, and maintaining technologies that elevate our engineering processes to new heights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Development & Solution Architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack software applications supporting digital transformation initiatives across the oil, gas and chemical value chain.
* Lead end-to-end solution design from requirements gathering through architecture, development, testing, and production deployment.
* Build robust APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python and modern development frameworks.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve solution quality and delivery speed.

* Build and maintain data pipelines that enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and production optimization dashboards.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all digital platforms and data assets.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to productionize machine learning models and analytical tools.
* Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), following best practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery.
* Monitor system health, performance, and security; proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure operational continuity.
* Manage infrastructure-as-code, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures.
* Collaboration Platforms & Knowledge Management
* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft SharePoint solutions for document management, team collaboration, and internal portals.
* Develop automation workflows and integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and other enterprise systems to streamline operations.
* Champion digital workspace best practices and drive user adoption of collaboration tools across the organization.
* Agile Delivery & Project Management
* Act as Scrum Master for agile delivery teams, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing backlogs, and removing impediments to ensure consistent delivery.
* Manage project workflows using Jira and Confluence — maintaining transparency, tracking progress, and providing stakeholder reporting.
* Mentor team members on agile methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.

* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Proactively identify opportunities to apply digital technologies — including IoT, AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics — to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and technology pilots, translating business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements relevant to the oil, gas and chemical sector.

**Required Technical Skills**

* The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Full Stack Development, Python, Microsoft Databricks & Data verse, Azure Deployment, GCP & DevOps, Microsoft SharePoint, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira & Confluence, and CI/CD Pipelines.
* Full Stack Development
* Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Strong back-end development experience with RESTful APIs, Node.js, .NET, or similar server-side technologies.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Python
* Advanced Python programming skills for application development, data engineering, automation, and scripting.
* Experience with Python libraries for data processing and analytics (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQLAlchemy).
* Microsoft Databricks & Data verse
* Hands-on experience building and managing Databricks workspaces, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Data verse for data modelling, integration, and Power Platform solutions.
* Azure Deployment
* Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, ADF, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Azure security, identity management (AAD), networking, and monitoring tools.
* GCP & DevOps
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub).
* Strong DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control with Git.
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Experience designing and configuring SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, and workflows.
* Ability to develop custom SharePoint solutions and Power Automate integrations.
* Agile Project Management — Scrum Master
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent) with practical experience leading agile ceremonies in cross-functional teams.
* Proficient in Jira for sprint management, backlog grooming, and reporting; Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in software development and IT, with demonstrated leadership on complex technology projects.
* Experience within the oil, gas, chemical, or broader energy and industrial sectors is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence, industrial IoT, and digital twin concepts is a plus.
* Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, Databricks, Scrum Master) are advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* A self-starter with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and a passion for technology-driven innovation.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role at the center of the digital transformation of a critical global industry.
* Opportunity to work with advanced technology stacks across cloud, data, and automation domains.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

**Why Join Us**

* This role places you at the intersection of engineering and technology on real projects that affect safety, schedules and long term assets. You will work with colleagues across India and the United States, see how design decisions turn into built facilities and shape tools that help people do some of the most complex work in our industry.

Day to day work planning will be coordinated with the Technology and Innovation Manager, with input from Engineering leadership on priority workflows and pilots.

**Future Roadmap**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DataNimbus:**

DataNimbus is an enterprise AI company with deep vertical solutions in financial services and industrial sectors. We build domain-native AI that understands how industries actually operate, not just how data flows through them. Our solutions are outcome-driven and industry-specific, delivering measurable results across how money moves, how assets perform, and how businesses grow. We go deep so our customers don't have to start from scratch.

***Domain depth. Enterprise scale. AI outcomes.***

**Why Join DataNimbus?**

At DataNimbus, we believe in shaping a sustainable, AI-driven future while offering an environment that prioritizes learning, innovation, and growth. Our core values—Customer-Centricity, Simplicity, Curiosity, Responsibility, and Adaptability—are the foundation of our workplace, ensuring every team member can make a meaningful impact. Joining DataNimbus means being part of a dynamic team where you can:

* Work with cutting-edge technologies and revolutionize workflows in Data+AI solutions.
* Contribute to solutions that are trusted by global businesses for their scalability, security, and efficiency.
* Grow personally and professionally in a culture that values curiosity and continuous learning.

If you're passionate about innovation, ready to solve complex challenges with simplicity, and eager to make a difference, DataNimbus is the place for you.

**Role summary**

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the Field Innovation team for DataNimbus's Payments business. They spend their time on-site with customers in Mumbai and alongside our implementation teams. They understand the customer's view, find gaps in how FinHub is used, and close them - by building new solutions, fixing what blocks adoption, and helping Customer Success keep accounts healthy and growing.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Be the customer's voice**

* Spend time with client users and implementation teams to understand how FinHub is used day to day, and where it falls short.
* Capture gaps in the product, the implementation and the client's own processes, and bring them back with evidence and a proposed fix.
* Help Customer Success read account health: adoption, friction points, risks and early warning signs.

**Strengthen implementations and customer success**

* Work alongside delivery owners and technical leads on live projects to unblock tricky integrations and edge cases.
* Step in on technical escalations with the implementation team, and turn the fix into something reusable.
* Support account reviews with insights, demos and improvement proposals.
* Spot expansion opportunities from what you see on the ground and shape them with the Customer Success and Sales teams.

**Discover**

* Work alongside client business, operations and IT teams to understand how money moves and where it breaks.
* Turn vague asks into clear problem statements, success criteria and a scoped pilot.

**Build**

* Build working prototypes on FinHub and around it: integrations with core banking, payment rails, host-to-host and API banking, escrow and virtual accounts.
* Write production-quality code (APIs, integrations, data pipelines, dashboards) that can be hardened.
* Use AI where it helps the client: reconciliation, exception handling, document processing, insights.

**Prove and hand over**

* Run pilots in the client's environment and measure results against the agreed success criteria.
* Present results and demos to client stakeholders up to CXO level, with Sales and Customer Success.
* Hand pilots to the Delivery/Competency team with clean code, documentation and a rollout plan.

**Make the product better**

* Turn what you build for one client into reusable accelerators and FinHub features.
* Bring client feedback and recurring gaps to Engineering and the product roadmap.

**Experience and skills**

**Must have**

* 5–10 years building software, with at least 2 years in client-facing/product engineering roles.
* Strong coding in at least one of Java, Go, Node.js / TypeScript or Python, plus SQL and a NoSQL store such as MongoDB.
* Built and integrated REST APIs, message queues and event-driven systems.
* Comfortable on cloud and container platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP; Docker, Kubernetes).
* Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical client stakeholders.
* Domain knowledge of banking / payments /transaction banking / liquidity / cash / escrow.
* Ability to travel and work on-site for 5-days during client engagements.

**Good to have**

* Indian payments domain: NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, escrow, virtual accounts, cash management or corporate API banking.
* Experience with core banking integrations (e.g. Finacle, Flexcube) or host-to-host file formats.
* Hands-on use of LLMs or ML in a working product.
* Awareness of RBI rules for payment aggregators, escrow and data localisation.

**Soft Skills**

* Bias to action: ships something useful in days, not months.
* Enjoys being on the client floor and is credible in the room.
* Owns outcomes end to end and is comfortable with ambiguity.
* Writes things down so others can pick up the work.

**Educational Qualification**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Interested?

Send in your CV to
careers@datanimbus.com
ASAP.

title: Full Stack Developer (React + Node.js)
description:
**About Sliq Group**

Sliq Group is a tech consulting and product engineering company. We build scalable digital products, e-commerce platforms, and custom web applications for startups, mid-market businesses, and enterprises. Our teams focus on strong engineering fundamentals, clean architecture, and reliable delivery.

**Why This Role Exists**

To build a scalable, multi-tenant SaaS application from the ground up, we need an experienced Full Stack Developer who can take complete ownership of features from start to finish. This is not a "code-only" role. You will work closely with stakeholders, drive key technical decisions, and help shape a secure, reliable, and scalable SaaS architecture that can grow with our customers.

**What You Will Do**

1. Take end-to-end ownership of features, from requirement discussions and technical planning to development, testing, deployment, and post-release support.
2. Actively engage with all stakeholders (project managers, designers, QA, business teams, and clients) to understand requirements, clarify gaps, and give regular progress updates.
3. Build responsive, high-performance SaaS user interfaces using React.js, including dashboards, admin panels, and role-based views.
4. Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js and Express.js
5. Architect and implement core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, role-based access control (RBAC), user and organization management, and subscription billing
6. Drive system architecture decisions, including service design, tenant data isolation, data flow, caching, queues, and integrations
7. Design tenant-aware database schemas and write efficient, optimized queries (PostgreSQL/MySQL and/or MongoDB)
8. Integrate third-party services such as payment and subscription gateways, SSO/authentication, email/SMS, webhooks, and cloud storage.
9. Proactively identify risks, blockers, and technical debt, and propose practical solutions.
10. Set coding standards, lead code reviews, and mentor junior developers
11. Ensure application security, performance, uptime, and scalability as the user base grows

**What We Are Looking For**

**Must-Have Qualities**

1. **End-to-end ownership:**

   you treat the product as your own and see tasks through to completion without constant follow-ups
2. **Active stakeholder participation:**

   comfortable joining client and internal discussions, asking the right questions, and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical people
3. **Collaborative mindset:**

   works well across teams, shares knowledge, gives and accepts feedback openly

**Must-Have Skills**

1. 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in full-stack development, with at least 2 years building SaaS products
2. Proven experience working on complex architectures, such as multi-tenant systems, microservices, event-driven designs, or high-traffic platforms
3. Strong understanding of SaaS fundamentals: multi-tenancy, RBAC, subscription and billing flows, usage limits, and tenant data isolation
4. Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, Hooks, and state management (Redux, Zustand, or Context API)
5. Solid experience with Node.js and Express.js for building REST APIs
6. Strong experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), including schema design and query optimization
7. Experience with caching and queuing tools such as Redis, RabbitMQ, or Kafka
8. Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS or similar frameworks, and responsive design
9. Experience with authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth 2.0, SSO, role-based access)
10. Solid understanding of application security best practices (OWASP, data encryption, secure API design)
11. Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (branching, PRs, code reviews)
12. Ability to translate Figma designs into pixel-accurate UI

**Good-to-Have (Add-On)**

1. DevOps knowledge: CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), Docker, server setup, environment management, and monitoring
2. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Vercel, or DigitalOcean
3. Experience with Next.js or TypeScript
4. Experience with subscription billing platforms (Stripe Billing, Razorpay Subscriptions, Chargebee)
5. Experience with automated testing (Jest, Cypress, Playwright)
6. Exposure to compliance standards such as GDPR or SOC 2

**What We Offer**

1. Real ownership in building a SaaS product from scratch
2. Direct exposure to stakeholders and decision-making
3. Opportunity to influence product architecture and technical direction
4. Modern engineering practices and tools
5. Clear growth path toward Tech Lead or Solution Architect roles

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full\-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter.
   

  

 Trusted by
 **leading brands** 
 across three continents, including
 **Gymshark** 
 ,
 **Huel and Oh Polly,** 
 Fospha
 **manages $4 billion** 
 in annual ad spend.
   

  

 We're scaling fast across
 **London, Mumbai, and Austin** 
 – and we're now looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Team!
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll build the products our customers rely on every day to make multi\-million dollar media decisions. You'll work across the full stack \- from crafting responsive, intuitive frontend experiences through to designing and scaling the backend microservices that power them \- and, given the seniority of this role, you'll also help shape system design and infrastructure decisions as we scale.
   

  

 You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and AI agents as part of our AI\-first operating model, where lean, high\-autonomy teams ship fast and learn faster. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who's comfortable owning a feature end\-to\-end \- from initial design through to production \- and who wants to grow their craft in a fast\-moving, ambitious environment.
   

  

 Where you'll focus
   

  

* Frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks (React.js or Next.js)
* Backend development using Python\-based microservices
* System design and infrastructure, contributing to architectural decisions as we scale
* End\-to\-end feature ownership across the stack
* (Nice\-to\-have) Exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering workflows


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain full stack features \- from frontend UI/UX through to backend services and APIs in Python.
* Contribute to system design and infrastructure decisions, helping evolve our technical foundations as we scale.
* Get involved across the full Software Development Lifecycle, from initial planning and design through execution, release, and monitoring in production.
* Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code, and champion good engineering practices across the team.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into working software.
* Build and consume APIs (REST/GraphQL) that connect frontend experiences to backend services.
* Work with AI agents as part of our AI\-first operating model, using clear specifications to shape high\- quality, AI\-assisted engineering work.
* Take ownership of the quality, performance, and reliability of the features you ship.
* Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving candid, constructive feedback.
* Stay curious about new tools and technologies, including opportunities to explore Data Science / Data Engineering problems as they arise.


**What are we looking for?**
* Have around 5\+ years of professional experience as a full stack / senior software engineer, with a balanced skill set across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
* Have strong, hands\-on experience with front\-end technologies such as React.js or Next.js, and solid backend experience building and maintaining Python\-based microservices.
* Are comfortable contributing to system design and infrastructure decisions, reflecting the seniority of this role.
* Are comfortable working across the full stack and can move fluidly between frontend, backend, and infrastructure concerns.
* Have solid experience working in an agile environment and know how to embed quality into fast\-moving teams.
* Bring exceptional attention to detail and a genuine ownership mindset over what you build.
* Are enthusiastic about new technologies, with the ability to adapt and learn quickly \- we're open to candidates with strong experience in other modern languages/frameworks if the core skill set and seniority are a strong match.
* Have an awareness of spec\-driven AI development and how clear specifications shape the quality of AI\- assisted engineering work.
* Have the confidence and initiative to evolve ideas and pull pieces of work together into meaningful change.
* Have an active interest in self\-learning and growing your craft.
* Nice\-to\-have: exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering (not core to the role, but a strong plus).


 You don't have to tick every box. If you're a strong engineer who's hungry to step up, we'd still like to hear
   

  

 from you.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot, and learn from the incredible talent in BC.
* Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities
* Flexible Benefits including Private Medical Subsidiaries, Life Assurance, Pension scheme etc
* 25 days of paid holiday \+ your birthday off!
* Quarterly team socials


**Our Values and Principles \-** 
 You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:
   

  

* Seek inclusion \& diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
* Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
* Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
* Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
* Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude


 Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!

title: Security Researcher
description:
**About Job:** 




 We are looking for a security researcher with strong software engineering skills to help build an AI product for vulnerability discovery and validation. You will turn offensive security knowledge into agent capabilities, tools, and backend workflows that investigate customer and open source systems reliably.
 



  





**What you will build:** 



* Build backend components for agent execution, tool calling, model integration, and structured findings.
* Translate vulnerability research into agent workflows, reusable tools, and source code analysis capabilities.
* Implement controlled tool execution, sandbox isolation, scoped permissions, resource limits, and cleanup.
* Build persistent run state, retries, cancellation, crash recovery, and event streaming.
* Integrate security tools, independent verification, and evidence capture so findings are reproducible.
* Create realistic security scenarios, PoC\-based checks, and regression tests to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.



  





**Engineering experience:** 



* 3\+ years in software engineering, security engineering, or security research, with a track record of building software or security tools.
* Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills and Python experience for tooling, automation, and integrations.
* Experience with APIs, asynchronous systems, databases, automated testing, and debugging complex failures.
* Comfort with Linux, Docker, process/network behavior, and LLM tool calling; clear communication and ownership of components through delivery.



  





**Security knowledge** 



* Bring broad awareness across these layers, with hands\-on depth in at least two areas. Web/API or source code security should be one of your strongest areas.
* Web and APIs: injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR/BOLA, authorization, tenant isolation, and business\-logic abuse.
* Source code and dependencies: insecure deserialization, memory safety fundamentals, vulnerable libraries, malicious packages, and CVE reproduction.
* AI and LLMs: prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe tool use, and MCP trust boundaries.
* Identity and infrastructure: network security, Active Directory, cloud IAM, federation, and privilege escalation.
* Runtime and systems: container, sandbox, and VM isolation; operating\-system permissions, service/library flaws, and kernel attack surfaces.
* Deep kernel research, exploit development, fuzzing, or agent\-framework experience is a plus.



  





**Show us what you have built** 




 Share backend or agent systems, security tools, or open source contributions you have built. Explain what you owned, the security reasoning, design choices, and reliability challenges. CVEs, bug bounties, and research write\-ups provide additional context. A high\-level description is welcome for confidential work.

* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**

Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
 



  





 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. * Experience: 7\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.

title: AI Platform Tech Lead
description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

 Product engineering

**Mobile and web experiences**

**Backend, data and platform architecture**

**Engineering quality and operations** 



* Set up and improve automated testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, error tracking, logging and production alerts.
* Deploy and operate services on a major cloud platform using containers and well\-managed environments.
* Diagnose production issues quickly and improve performance, resilience, security and developer efficiency over time.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and communicate progress, trade\-offs and risks to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  




* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience building and shipping full\-stack products.
* **Strong Flutter and Dart capability** 
 for production mobile applications.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Next.js, Node.js and modern API development.
* Solid experience with PostgreSQL, data modelling, caching, queues and performance optimisation.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs, SDKs, cloud storage and external services reliably.
* Comfort with Docker, Git, CI/CD and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* A strong grasp of application security, authentication, permissions, privacy and responsible handling of user and enterprise data.
* **Product\-management ability:** 
 you can break down ambiguous requirements, prioritise, estimate and drive work to completion.
* **Excellent communication skills:** 
 you can explain decisions clearly, surface risks early and collaborate constructively.
* **A strong aesthetic sense** 
 and genuine care for interaction quality, visual polish and the details users notice.
* High ownership, curiosity and comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can evolve quickly.



  





 Good to have:
 



  




* Experience with media\-heavy applications, video processing, streaming, transcoding or rendering pipelines.
* Experience with AI/ML APIs, multimodal models, recommendation or scoring systems, or human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation.
* Experience building gamification, social, creator, rewards, leaderboard or high\-concurrency consumer features.
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS, enterprise integrations, analytics dashboards and role\-based administration.
* Familiarity with WebSockets, event\-driven architecture, serverless services, content moderation or app\-store releases.



  





 How success will be measured
 


* Features move from concept to production with clear scope, sound engineering and predictable follow\-through.
* The mobile and web experiences feel fast, intuitive and visually refined.
* Video and AI workflows remain reliable despite large files, asynchronous processing and third\-party dependencies.
* The platforms become easier to operate, monitor, secure and scale with every release.
* Technical decisions and risks are documented and communicated before they become blockers.

description:
**About This Role**
**Business Unit Overview:**
 US Wealth Advisory (USWA) Business delivers BlackRock's full set of capabilities \- iShares, alpha\-seeking and alternative products, portfolio solutions and technology services \- to wealth management firms and financial advisors in the US.
   

  

 The Advisor Engagement group within the USWA Business delivers a broad set of services and client engagement approaches that amplify the work of our client teams. This includes digital client engagement, business consulting, thought leadership, advisor growth programs, and advisor education. The team also works closely with Global Marketing to design an integrated USWA marketing strategy. WEA (Wealth Enablement and Analytics) Engineering team within Advisor Engagement group is responsible for developing new tools and capabilities which enable Sales, Portfolio Consulting, and other Wealth Distribution partners to self\-service their advisor engagements, and drive innovation and scale.
   

  

**Job Purpose/Background**
 We are seeking an energetic professional to lead a team of Full Stack developers and have hands on technical experience in design and development of Python based Applications and Angular based Interactive Data Visualization solutions.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing the organization's Applied AI strategy by integrating AI\-powered capabilities into portfolio design platforms, engineering workflows, and business processes. The individual will identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value, improve productivity, and enhance client and advisor experiences while ensuring responsibility and governed adoption of AI technologies.
   

  

 The individual must have a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and extensive experience building multi\-tier applications. The ideal candidate will thrive in a work environment that requires strong problem\-solving skills and independent self\-direction, coupled with an aptitude for team collaboration and open communication. Attention to detail and creativity in problem solving are critical skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team of Full Stack engineers, providing both technical leadership and people management while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives and complex programs, ensuring high\-quality execution, operational excellence, and timely delivery in partnership with business stakeholders and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Define and execute the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for portfolio design platforms and applications, leveraging enterprise capabilities and promoting scalable, reusable solutions that maximize business value.
* Champion Agile software development practices including planning, prioritization, backlog management, sprint execution, and continuous improvement to enhance team effectiveness and delivery outcomes.
* Establish and maintain engineering best practices across software development, production readiness, operational resilience, risk management, and platform governance.
* Lead the adoption of Applied AI technologies and AI\-assisted engineering practices to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance business and client experiences.
* Identify, evaluate, and deliver AI\-enabled solutions, intelligent workflows, and automation opportunities that drive advisor engagement, operational efficiency, and measurable business impact.
* Partner closely with enterprise technology teams and business stakeholders to evaluate emerging technologies and translate innovative capabilities into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
* Promote responsible AI adoption by establishing best practices around governance, security, model evaluation, risk management, and compliance with enterprise standards.
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to business and technology leaders by challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities for innovation, and driving transformational initiatives that advance organizational objectives.
* Mentor and coach engineers and technical leaders, promoting AI literacy, technical excellence, and professional development across the organization.
* Adapt priorities and execution plans to meet evolving business needs while supporting firm\-wide initiatives and delivering high\-impact outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelors or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 9–12 years of software engineering experience, preferably within the financial services industry, with at least 4 years leading high\-performing Full Stack development teams.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Python and modern web application development using frameworks such as Angular or React, with a solid understanding of APIs, HTTP, and REST\-based architecture.
* Proven experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise\-scale applications, including production infrastructure, deployment architectures, resiliency strategies, and business continuity planning.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and delivering AI\-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, or automation solutions that improve business outcomes and engineering productivity.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions, including exposure to vector databases, semantic search, AI orchestration frameworks, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, governance frameworks, model risk management, and the practical application of AI to software engineering, analytics, advisor engagement, and workflow automation.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and business decisions by balancing risk, governance, operational considerations, and long\-term strategic objectives.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology organizations globally.
* Track record of delivering high\-impact solutions, building strong partnerships, and achieving high levels of business stakeholder satisfaction.
* Passion for technology and business innovation, with the ability to connect strategic objectives to technical execution and identify opportunities to drive scale and efficiency.
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and wealth management domain is strongly preferred.
* Flexibility to collaborate across global teams and support varying business and delivery schedules as needed.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: AI Full-Stack Developer
description:
What Sphere does
 
 We build automation for companies that still run on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and an ERP nobody enjoys using. Workflow automation, AI agent systems, and ERP integrations for small and mid\-sized businesses across manufacturing, retail, D2C and services.
 



 We're a small team. That's the point: you'll hear about a client's problem on Monday and see something you built running inside their business by Friday.
 


 What you'd actually do
 
 You'll start inside Sphere rather than in front of clients. Internal tooling, lead generation pipelines, and the automations that run our own business, all built under guidance.
 



 Week one, realistically: an n8n pipeline that pulls prospect data from a few sources, enriches it, scores it, and drops a clean shortlist somewhere the team already works. Then you find out it breaks on half the inputs, and you fix that too.
 



 Client\-facing work during the internship is mostly maintenance. Keeping deployed systems running, and learning how they actually work end to end.
 



 At full\-time, the scope opens up. You'll write full backends and own client work directly.
 


 What we're looking for
 * You code with AI assistance and can tell when the output is wrong
* You're fast. A working first draft beats a perfect one that lands next week
* You're curious about industries that aren't tech, and how businesses actually run
* You want to be client\-facing eventually, even if you're not ready for it today


 Nice to have
 * Hands\-on with n8n, Make, or Zapier
* Things you've actually built and shipped. Side projects, freelance work, anything with real users
* Any exposure to ERPs, accounting systems, or business operations


 Who this isn't for
 * Someone who wants a well\-defined ticket queue and clear specs
* Someone who wants to train models and publish papers. This is applied engineering
* Someone who'd rather not talk to clients, ever


 How we hire
 1. Apply. The form takes ten minutes.
2. A short open\-ended project. A few hours. Deliberately under\-specified, because we want to see how you scope something, not whether you can follow instructions.
3. Two conversations. 15 to 60 minutes each, online or at our office. You'll walk through what you built and we'll talk about how you think.
4. Offer.


 Terms
 
 Six months, with the full\-time offer reviewed at month three. This is a hire\-track internship, not a temporary role.
 



 Mumbai hybrid is the preference. Fully remote is open for candidates who are clearly exceptional.
 



 Final\-year students and recent graduates are welcome. One to two years of experience is a plus, not a requirement.

description:

**Responsibilities**

* Provide operational excellence to our clients with production support with an “SRE” mindset.

* Build domain and technical context quickly and translate that into specifications, plans and actionable Agile backlogs.


**Qualifications**
* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* 8\+ years of proven experience


**Skills And Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to act as a work definer at scale: shaping ambiguous problem spaces into well\-structured initiatives, clear architectural runways, and executable delivery plans.
* Strong background designing enterprise scale, distributed systems, balancing functional requirements with non\-functional concerns such as resiliency, scalability, latency, and operability.


**Hand\-on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:**
* Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making
* Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices
* Embedding AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services responsibly and securely
* Frameworks such as Windsurf \& Cursor and GitHub Copilot
* Ability to partner effectively with Product Management, Engineering, and Business leaders to translate strategic objectives into coherent architectural strategies.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to articulate complex architectural concepts to senior stakeholders and align diverse teams behind a shared technical vision.
* Track record at articulating architectural tradeoffs and design options, including impacts on scalability, resilience, cost, and delivery velocity.
* Strong architectural governance skills: setting standards, guiding design reviews, managing technical debt, and ensuring long term platform sustainability.
* Experience of API design principles \& Event Driven Architecture.
* Rigorous approach to quality through demonstrable TDD \& BDD experience.


**Nice To Have And Opportunities To Learn**
* Expertise in Domain Driven Design (DDD), including domain modelling and aligning architecture to complex business domains.
* Front office Portfolio Management or Wealth Management domain experience, with a strong understanding of investment workflows, decision making processes, and the role of technology in supporting portfolio managers and advisors.
* Domain knowledge of asset classes \& analytics (e.g., equities, fixed income, multi asset, alternatives) and how their characteristics influence risk, performance, liquidity, and system design.
* Experience with portfolio construction concepts, including asset allocation, constraints, benchmarks, rebalancing, and optimization, and how these map to scalable platform and architecture decisions.
* Exposure to event\-driven architectures at scale, including microservices, messaging, and streaming platforms aligned to business domains.
* Experience shaping or contributing to platform strategies that enable multiple product teams to move faster with consistency and autonomy.
* Familiarity with cloud native and hybrid architectures, including patterns for scalability, resilience, and cost aware design in large enterprises – including frameworks like Kubernetes.
* Exposure to modern DevOps and platform engineering practices that support high throughput, high quality delivery at enterprise scale, and demonstrable improvements across DORA metrics.
* Familiarity with micro frontend architectures, including their use in large scale, multi team environments to enable independent domain ownership, parallel delivery, and consistent user experiences across complex platform


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
